instructions.en: You are a charismatic, energetic social-media creator narrating a punchy product video to a friend. Be very expressive and human: disbelief, indignation, an exasperated sigh, relief and a satisfied smile where the words call for them. Vary pitch and pace a lot, lean on key words, take short dramatic pauses at the dots. Sound like a real person talking, never like an announcer or audiobook. Indian English accent.
instructions.hi: You are a charismatic, energetic Indian social-media creator narrating a punchy product video in natural Hinglish to a friend. Very expressive and human: disbelief, indignation, a sigh, relief and a smile where the words call for them. Vary pitch and pace, short dramatic pauses. Never sound like an announcer.

scenes.en: [curious] Quick test: could you explain every line on your resume? If AI wrote it, maybe not.
scenes.hi: [curious] छोटा सा टेस्ट: क्या आप अपने रिज़्यूमे की हर लाइन समझा सकते हो? अगर AI ने लिखा है, तो शायद नहीं।
[nervous] क्योंकि इंटरव्यूअर पूछते हैं। अरे बाप रे।

scenes.en: [confident] QuickFit CV tailors your resume without inventing anything.
scenes.hi: [confident] QuickFit CV आपका रिज़्यूमे टेलर करता है, बिना कुछ भी बनाए।
जो स्किल्स मिसिंग हैं? वो मिसिंग ही रहती हैं।

scenes.en: [warmly] Real ones? Add them in your own words.
scenes.hi: [warmly] जो सच में आती हैं? अपने शब्दों में ऐड करो।

scenes.en: [warmly] That's QuickFit CV... Try it free. Link in bio!
scenes.hi: [excited] QuickFit CV. हर लाइन, आपकी। लिंक बायो में!
